Mister Rogers shows a video about how people make peanut butter. Lady Aberlin agrees to take care of Daphne. Henrietta Pussycat suggests making a daycare center at the factory, and Corney agrees.

Mister Rogers meets Natasha, a famous oboeist. She shows pictures of her children and says she expresses her feelings for them through her music. Prince Tuesday is considering getting sick so that his parents will stay home from work.

Marilyn Barnett invites Mister Rogers outside for some exercises.  Bruce Franco carries a collection of balloon scuptures he has made for the party. He gives Mister Rogers a balloon sculpture that looks like the Neighborhood Trolley.

Mister Rogers introduces a week of programs about the environment. He shows how things can be reused. In the Neighborhood of Make-Believe, there's a real-life problem -- too much garbage -- and the neighbors are trying to find a solution.

Mister Rogers arrives with a bandage on his left hand. He pulls back the bandage to show that his hand is still there. Ana scraped her paw but does not want a bandage. Lady Aberlin is able to convince her otherwise.

Mister Rogers shows a film about how people make adhesive bandages. Prince Tuesday is looking for someone to play with but all of his friends are busy. At the suggestion of King Friday, he pretends that his rag doll has come to life.

Mister Rogers shows a video of wolves "singing," and wolf expert Kent Weber stops by with two wolves and explains that wolves are shy, not big and bad like in the fairy tales, and how they live together in families.
Folksinger Ella Jenkins visits Mister Rogers with her ukulele and shares songs her father enjoyed.
Yo-Yo Ma describes how he misses his family when he is gone and plays Bach's Sarabande on his cello. Sitting at the piano, Yo-Yo's son Nicholas plays the Skater's Waltz as a duet with his father.

Mister Rogers goes to Brockett's Bakery to decorate gingerbread men. After hearing the sound effect from the laughing box, Lady Aberlin sees how long neighbors take to laugh. Eric Kloss makes different sounds using a wind synthesizer.
Mister Rogers plays with different-sized cardboard tubes. Lady Aberlin is observing how neighbors react to the laughter box. Dr. Maggie Kimmel tells the story of “Button Broth.”

Mister Rogers shows a video of how people make toothbrushes. Lady Aberlin observes the neighbors' reactions after she can turn herself into a tiger. Princess Zelda arrives in the Neighborhood of Make-Believe.
Mister Rogers brushes his teeth in his bathroom talks about how important it is to take care of our teeth, and even visits a dentist's office!

Mister Rogers shows a film of an earthmover digging a hole. Mr. McFeely shows a toothpaste video. Lady Aberlin wears a tiger suit, so she can be related to Daniel. Daniel declares that they are related by their hearts.

At the request of a television neighbor, Mister Rogers arrives with a model car and uses wooden blocks to build a roadway for it to travel. Prince Tuesday does not understand why he is not big like Neighbor Aber and King Friday.

Mister Rogers plants a seed and visits a conservatory. King Friday orders Handyman Negri to sing a song about not being afraid. This makes the neighbors even more anxious about the “big thing” that is to arrive in the neighborhood.

Mister Rogers brings in a cat named Jimmy and remembers him as a kitten. He shows pictures of babies that have grown into adults. Everyone gathers at the castle just as the big thing rolls into the Neighborhood of Make-Believe.

Mister Rogers says that the bean plant he planted a few days ago has grown. Robert Troll is the only one who can communicate with the “big thing.” He learns that it wants a blanket; the blanket causes it to sprout a stem and leaves.

Mister Rogers plays games that require patience.  Purple Panda experiments with a powder that causes flowers to grow. Prince Tuesday wishes the powder to make him grow. Mister Rogers goes to see the Harlem Spiritual Ensemble practice.
Harriett Cow shares the plans for a play. Lady Aberlin is greeted by a ballet dancer who dances her around the Neighborhood. The dancer inspires Ana Platypus to be a ballerina in the school play.

Mister Rogers explains why he changes into a sweater and sneakers, and shows how people make sweaters and sneakers. Miss Paulificate brings Prince Tuesday's ragdoll to life by dancing with him. The neighbors decide their roles in a play.
Mister Rogers plays dress-up with wigs and glasses, and says: “You can get dressed up in the fanciest of things, but the best style comes from inside, and it often spreads on your face with a smile.”

King Friday suggests that the Neighborhood of Make-Believe be turned upside down to see if the missing crown might fall out. Trolley finds the spare crown! Mister Rogers visits the Boys Choir of Harlem.

Maggie Stewart is dressed as Mr. McFeely and delivers a film about how people make sweaters. The children put on a play about a princess, a raccoon and a giant king. Prince Tuesday admits he had something to do with the missing crown.

Mister Rogers sees Bob Trow paint a portrait of Mr. McFeely. Robert Troll paints a portrait of King Friday who asks Lady Aberlin to have everyone copy it for themselves. Lady Aberlin explains that art comes from within each person.

Mister Rogers arrives with a wooden toy airplane. Handyman Negri is working on a musical portrait of King Friday. Neighbor Aber provides his own tribute to King Friday as he mans his plane and draws a sky-written portrait of the King.
Mister Rogers shows a picture of a blue tree. In art, you can make things any way you want. He also talks about visiting art museums.
Mister Rogers "colors a song" by playing music by Mozart to inspire his artwork. King Friday is curious about a delivery to X the Owl labelled "Deliver to X the Owl ONLY."

5ff4b9ccf938f8000779eb99: El grupo de Usopp y Robin, que está a cargo de la Operación SOP, idea un plan para separar a Trébol de Sugar y así poder tomarlos desprevenidos. Pero la tribu Tontatta ha subestimado a su enemigo y ahora deberá enfrentar las consecuencias.

Trébol desata su furia destruyendo la torre de los oficiales. En consecuencia, Usopp quiere emprender la huida, pero los Tontatta se rehúsan. Una revelación hará que Usopp comprenda la resolución y la esperanza de los Tontatta.
Luffy, Violet y el Soldado por fin llegan a su destino, la sala en la que se encuentra Doflamingo, pero Violet le dice a Luffy que debe esperar a que la Operación SOP concluya primero.
Para los Tontatta, que están en grave peligro, Usoland es su única salvación. Pero Usopp solo piensa en huir.
Se revela el pasado del Soldado de Juguete: Kyros, el mayor héroe en la historia del coliseo Corrida y comandante del ejercito del rey Riku. Una bestia salvaje con las manos manchadas de sangre.
Los recuerdos del Soldado de Juguete siguen apareciendo: el coraje de ver a su rey destronado, la impotencia al ver morir a su amada, la desesperación de ser olvidado.

¡Usopp consigue dejar inconsciente a Sugar y la Operación SOP tiene éxito! Los juguetes de Dressrosa empiezan a recuperar sus formas originales y la gente se va dando cuenta de quién es Doflamingo en realidad.

Al tiempo que una conmoción sin precedentes recorre el palacio, la batalla por la fruta Mera Mera al fin se termina. Mientras tanto, en el puerto de intercambio subterráneo, Usopp protagoniza una revelación celestial.
El misterioso Lucy que heredó los poderes y la voluntad de Ace desciende a la oscuridad de Dressrosa. ¡Y cuando se revele su impactante identidad, empezará una nueva historia de los tres hermanos!
Doflamingo les muestra la dura realidad a todos los que están reunidos en el palacio con la intención de acabar con su vida y pone a los habitantes de Dressrosa en una situación crítica.
Ahora que Dressrosa se ha convertido en un campo de batalla, Doflamingo ha emprendido una cruzada para acabar con Luffy y los demás.
Luffy, Law y Zoro se dirigen a enfrentar a Doflamingo, pero los rodean oficiales de alto rango de la Familia, además de piratas salvajes que quieren conseguir la recompensa.
Luffy y Zoro se enfrentan a Fujitora. Y mientras continúa la intensa pelea, el silencioso oficial del más alto rango, Pica, emerge del suelo haciendo un ruido que hace temblar la tierra y el Cielo.
Frente a uno de sus peores enemigos, el supergigante Pica, los guerreros que lucharon a muerte entre sí en el coliseo se unen a Luffy.
El grupo de rufianes que dirige Luffy avanza hacia el palacio. Sin embargo, el gigante Pica lanza un puñetazo sin piedad que obstruye su camino.

Al tiempo que cada una de las batallas empieza a intensificarse, Zoro se enfrenta a Pica, quien usa su cuerpo verdadero. Por otro lado, Law habla sobre los sentimientos que tenía ocultos en su corazón.

Luffy se abre paso entre los guardias de Doflamingo de camino al refugio de este, mientras que en la parte baja el Almirante Fujitora se enfrenta a Sabo, que tiene el poder del Puño de Fuego tras haberse comido la Fruta Llama-Llama.

Sabo intenta averiguar las intenciones de Fujitora mientras pelea duramente contra él.
